headline: Oracle Faces Pressure: Data Center Costs and OpenAI Exposure Weigh on Stock
summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) stock fell on Wednesday as traders highlighted massive data center cost overruns, credit default risk, and heavy exposure to OpenAI.

summary: Moody’s Corporation (NYSE: MCO) stock rises after delivering strong second-quarter earnings, raising full-year profit guidance, and expanding its share buyback program to $3 billion.
